# Cloudflare Computer: Persistent Filesystems for AI Agents

**Source:** https://www.instagram.com/reel/Db2FJERS0N_/ · **Type:** Reel · **Author:** Angelo Trifanoff · **Saved:** 2026-10-02

## Summary

Cloudflare open-sourced Cloudflare Computer, a project designed to give AI agents durable context across sessions via an SQLite-backed virtual filesystem. Instead of repeatedly spinning up Linux containers for routine file operations like sorting or searching, it handles them natively and minimizes container usage. This allows agents to seamlessly retain file context between tasks without starting from scratch.
